areas.t: For Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, high pressure will remain centered over the Upper Midwest. Winds will remain light with the high pressure centered near the area. The light winds will cause a bit of stagnation and an uptick in particulate. Air quality may reach Yellow (Moderate) in the Twin Citi
